notes.title: RUSHING BEAT X: Return Of Brawl Brothers’ Demo Now Available
notes.content: [h3][b]◆CHARACTER[/b][/h3][p]In this demo, you can play as 4 out of the 6 characters available in the full version:[/p][p][/p][p]Rick Norton – A former detective with balanced stats. He excels in a mix of strikes and throws.[/p][p]Douglas Bild – A former pro-wrestler turned cop. He specializes in powerful throw-based attacks.[/p][p]Kahlua – A girl who has lost her memory. Agile and well-rounded, she focuses on quick combos and aerial attacks.[/p][p]Kazan – A successor of the Togakure-style ninjutsu. A speed-type character capable of fast strikes and triple jumps.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]◆ACTION[/b][/h3][p]Thanks to auto combos with simple controls, even beginners can enjoy exhilarating action.[/p][p]Use counterattacks, follow-ups, and weapons you pick up to create your own unique combos.[/p][p]Most actions can be canceled into dashes or jumps. Master canceling and unleash relentless assaults![/p][p]Throws can be directed with key inputs. Send enemies flying and hit targets behind them![/p][p]You can even destroy background objects by throwing enemies into them—sometimes revealing hidden items.[/p][p]Landing or taking hits will charge your Rage Gauge. Once it’s full, you’ll enter Rage Mode![/p][p]Gain offensive and defensive boosts and unleash your ultimate technique, Beat Rush.[/p][p]Let your righteous fury crush evil![/p][p][/p][h3][b]◆DIRECTOR'S MESSAGE[/b][/h3][p][i]“I want even beginners to experience the thrill of chaining combos. The more you play, the more strategic depth opens up. I hope everyone enjoys the variety of actions.”[/i][/p][p][i]That’s the concept we’ve built this game around.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Strike enemies head-on, unleash aerial acrobatics, or chain throws to wipe out crowds.[/i][/p][p][i]You can also battle using all kinds of weapons.[/i][/p][p][i]Find your own favorite way to fight![/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]And don’t miss the new drama and backstory, finally revealed after all these years since the ‘90s.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]— “When it comes to burgers, I’m all about that classic combo: fries and cola.” Director Watanabe[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]◆FEEDBACK[/b][/h3][p]We’d love to hear your thoughts and impressions of the demo![/p][p]Please share your feedback in the thread on the Community Hub.[/p][p]Every comment will be read and considered for the development of the full version.[/p]
